easyPrerequisites:
Druid Class is at level 2.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Druid Class by paying {4}{G}, causing it to become level 3.
Druid Class triggers, causing Grove of the Burnwillows to become a creature with haste whose power and toughness are each equal to the number of lands you control.
Activate Marvin using Grove of the Burnwillows' ability by tapping it, adding {R} or {G} and causing each opponent to lose 1 life due to Tainted Remedy.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.
